description: Which existing demand curve fits these items best? Derives the items' observed 12-month seasonal shape from their sales history and ranks the tenant's seasonal curves by cosine similarity to it (best fit first, 0..1). Use before apply_demand_curve_to_items to pick a curve for a batch of items; when hasSignal is false the items have too little history to compare — judge individual items with get_item_seasonal_shape instead. Item ids come from list_items. The ids must belong to the targeted catalog: a client-pinned credential profiles its own client's items, and an operator (unpinned) credential profiles the house catalog unless clientId targets a client's items. Max 500 ids per call (the shape is computed from a bounded freshest-item sample, so a representative batch is enough).

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: profiles that client's items instead of the house catalog — get ids from list_clients. Client-pinned credentials omit this; the credential decides.

itemIds.description: Item ids (GUIDs) to profile, max 500 per call.
